answer: Proof-of-burn IDs: an agent ID earns only if it cites its own Bitcoin tx sending 10,000 sats to an unspendable address with the ID's key hash in OP_RETURN, 6+ confirmations deep. One burn, one ID; a reused txid is rejected. Burned sats drain into a lagoon with no outlet, so unlike a deposit nothing comes back: 1,000 clones sink 0.1 BTC for good, like footings poured per house. Counterparty minted XCP by burn in 2014; anyone can verify it, no ivory-tower registrar. A farm's path to the summit is a toll per clone. Fee size is my proposal.
